name: India Gate and Kartavya Path
notes: Everything inside the hexagon and the vista is lawn, canal and avenue; the monuments come from the landmark registry.

footpath.surface: reddish-pink crushed stone and paved walk, a tiled central path at the vista with a stone edge
footpath.notes: after the evening closure people walk on the road

lamps.kind: classical cast lamp: black post with a lantern head

kinds: low green iron railing with white stone posts and chains along the lawn and canal edge
low chain bollards at the hexagon
police barricades striped yellow and black

life.people: families, tourists and school groups in the evening; joggers and cyclists in the early morning; crowds at parade rehearsals and Republic Day events; ice cream and balloon sellers outside the lawns near the gate

road.condition: grey asphalt in very good condition, solid yellow centre line, white dashed lane lines, no kerb paint

evidence.footpath: sheet india_gate_kartavya_path 'Footpaths': a 6 to 8 m band of reddish-pink crushed stone and paved walk each side, a paved central line with a stone edge, a very low plain stone kerb, people walk on the road in the evening after closure
evidence.lamps: sheet india_gate_kartavya_path 'Street lamps': black cast posts 6 to 8 m tall with a lantern head, regular 30 m spacing, warm light
evidence.boundaries: sheet india_gate_kartavya_path 'Boundaries': low green iron railing with white stone posts and chains, low chain-link bollards at the hexagon, yellow and black barricade stripes, no walls
evidence.greenery: sheet india_gate_kartavya_path 'Trees and planting': rows of large avenue trees (jamun, neem, arjun) lining both sides and forming a visual wall
evidence.props: sheet india_gate_kartavya_path 'Parking and vehicles': very few parked cars, police vans at barricades
evidence.life: sheet india_gate_kartavya_path 'Vendors and street life' (evening crowds, vendors outside the lawns near the gate, early morning joggers, parade rehearsal) and 'Parking and vehicles' (tourist buses at the hexagon edge, very few parked cars)
evidence.sound: sheet india_gate_kartavya_path 'What makes this area unlike the others': the widest, flattest, most formal space; if it looks busy it is wrong
evidence.wear: sheet india_gate_kartavya_path 'Typical clutter and wear': wear 0.0 to 0.03; DELHI_WORLD.md 2a table 0.03
evidence.road: sheet india_gate_kartavya_path 'Road surface and markings': three lanes each side, grey asphalt in very good condition, yellow solid centre line; 'Typical clutter and wear': very clean
